qpltw5.description_en:
Adagio Holdings
A Proud Equal Opportunity Employer
> About us <
As the leading procurer and distributor of salvage rights, Adagio Holdings are now looking to expand into the acquisition and distribution of salvageable materials to both small and large-scale businesses.
> About the job <
As a part of this initiative, we need keen-eyed contractors capable of identifying salvageable materials, efficiently stripping them, and delivering the Recycle Material Composite (RMC) and salvaged components to us.
This introductory contract will require you to head to [LOCATION] and strip an abandoned ship approved for salvage.
Once you've gathered the RMC, you'll deliver it to the freight elevator located at [DESTINATION].
> Requirements <
- Any class/size of salvage ship
For advice on salvaging, consult A Salvager's Guide to Material Collection in your mobiGlas journal.
> Disclaimer <
Contractors are responsible for ensuring that they are collecting materials from vehicles that are considered fair salvage under the pursuant UEE laws. Adagio Holdings is in no way liable for any crimes or misdemeanors committed by contractors and will offer no compensation or reparation for any persons affected by these actions.

udm7nw.description_en:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------
ASD reached out to us as it seems one of their old labs, [LOCATION], still has some cargo being stored there they want to get their hands on.
You would fly there in a ship that can handle containers up to 32 SCU in size, land in the hangar, load up from the freight elevator, and then transport it all back to [DESTINATION].
Just be sure to keep your head on swivel while you’re at the facility and try not to let your curiosity get the better of you Abandoned sites like this can be home to all sort of nastiness. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.
BE YOUR BEST – Take pride in the work you do and you’ll do work to be proud of.
udm7nw.description_zh:
红风物流
“您的货物，有我保障”
----------------------------

联合科学与开发公司(ASD)联系了我们，好像是他们以前的一个实验室，<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，那里还存放着一些他们想要取回的物资。

你应该驾驶一艘能够能装下最大 <EM4>[MAX_SCU]</EM4> 尺寸的集装箱的飞船，降落在机库中，通过货运电梯装货，然后把所有东西运回 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。

在设施那边的时候，一定要保持警惕，别让好奇心占了上风。像这样的废弃地点可能会藏着各种危险的东西。还有别忘了随身携带一个<EM4>手持式牵引光束</EM4>。

尽力做到最好 – 为你所做的工作感到自豪，这样你就会做出值得骄傲的成绩。

9xyegy.description_en:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.
Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near [LOCATION] and likely rearming for another attack.
We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.
Stows out

最近一群人袭击了我们的物资运输队，法官想要迅速消灭他们，这也不奇怪。我们得知他们位于 [LOCATION] 附近，可能正在重新武装准备再次攻击。

我们希望你去那里，让他们后悔没有和他们的老帮派一起死去。

- 斯托斯通讯完毕。

us5le5.description_en:
Hi,
Another day another beacon. There's a [SHIP] looking to be topped up with [FUELTYPE] at [LOCATION]. The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.
I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.
If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.
Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say.
Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.
Just do the job and get home safe, okay?
Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"
us5le5.description_zh:
嗨，

又是新的一天，又有一个信标。在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 那边有一艘 <EM4>[SHIP]</EM4> 希望能补充 [FUELTYPE]。客户飞船将按 [REFUELREQUEST] 的价格向你支付报酬。作为旅者联合俱乐部的承包商，完成任务后你还将获得上述列出的 UWC 服务费。

我也不骗你：那地方一旦被困住可不好受，要是被偷袭就更糟糕了。我们在那儿已经损失了不少人 - 哪怕是运气好活下来的，回家时也缺胳膊少腿的。

如果你决定接这活儿，帮我个忙，时刻提高警惕。如果你有个朋友正好有空，不妨叫上他搭把手做点支援。

也许是我多虑了，但这并不意味着他们不会找你麻烦，正如德洛特妈妈常说的那样。
其实她从来没说过这话 - 不过我敢打赌，如果她靠这个谋生，她肯定这么说。

把活儿干完，平安回家，好吗？

迪娜·德洛特
调度中心
旅者联合俱乐部
“我们是你坚实的后盾。”

Something unusual seems to have occurred over at [LOCATION]. One of our contractors seems to have gone rogue after completing their assignment, refusing to communicate with us, and indiscriminately attacking those they come across. Now, I have other methods for dealing with renegade assets but our client still requires confirmation of the original target’s death which we are unable to provide due to this pilot’s presence.
I need you to head to the location and identify that [TARGET] is well and truly dead, preferably without being obliterated by this former, disgruntled contractor. As a fair warning, they were one of our most thorough, and ruthless employees, so extreme caution is advised. You will want to bring your most competent of allies to support you with this.
Sincerely,
Vaughn
gnuhsu.description_zh:
我有一个非常具体的任务，需要我最得力的人来完成。

好像在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 那边发生了一些不寻常的事情。我们的一位承包商完成任务后似乎变得叛变了，拒绝跟我们沟通，还无差别地攻击遇到的任何人。现在，我有其他办法对付这些叛变的人，但我们的客户仍然需要确认原来目标已经死了，而由于这个飞行员的存在，我们无法提供这种确认。

我需要你去那个地点，确认 <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4> 确实已经死了，最好是在这位前不满的承包商摧毁他之前。作为善意提醒，他们是我们在职员工中最彻底、最无情的一个，所以必须格外小心。你最好带上最能干的盟友来支持你。

此致，
沃恩

An opportunity has presented itself for a client to take action against a group of criminals who have been harassing their business.
According to reports, this group of outlaws are currently laying low at [LOCATION]. The client thinks this is a good time to catch them off guard and bring them to justice. The job is to take out their fuel tanks and putting an end to their smuggling operations once and for all.
These folks are not to be underestimated. You better bring some backup and fly low to avoid the turrets. Priority as always is the fuel tanks.
Good luck,
Eugene Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

mwc3rp.description_en:
MISSION SPECS
Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has been tracking increased outlaw activity in certain sectors of the system. This activity in conjunction with other intelligence leads us to believe that outlaws are planning an attack on elements traveling from the UEE. We're aiming to patrol these sectors and disrupt any plans before they can be put into action.
Currently, we need someone who can help patrol a highly dangerous sector. Once you've accepted the mission, you can proceed to the location marker on your HUD. From there, we'll send you along a specific route with additional waypoints to scan. Complete the patrol and we'll send the main contractor a bonus of 18 MG Scrip.
Due to the high probability of attack and general threat level of local outlaws, we recommend recruiting trusted wingmen to provide combat support.
Respectfully,
Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions
This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.
mwc3rp.description_zh:
任务说明

行动区域：尼克斯星系
敌对势力：不法分子
装备规格：战斗级飞船
任务简报：互安一直在追踪星系某些区域的不法分子活动有所增加。结合其他情报，我们认为这些不法分子正在策划对来自 UEE 的船只发动攻击。我们的目标是巡逻这些区域，在他们的计划实施之前予以破坏。

目前，我们需要有人协助巡逻一个危险性极高的区域。一旦你接受任务，就可以前往 HUD 上的<EM4>位置标记</EM4>。从那里，我们会为你提供一条包含多个检查点的具体路线。完成巡逻后，我们将向主承包商发放 <EM4>[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵凭证</EM4>的奖励。

由于攻击的可能性很高且当地不法分子的威胁等级较高，我们建议<EM4>招募可靠的僚机</EM4>以提供战斗支援。

此致，
迪肯·托宾
运营经理
互安防务

本通讯内容是一份非约束性的提议，一旦接受，任何一方都可以在不另行通知的情况下立即终止。所有行动均由承包商自行承担风险，并且必须遵守 UEE 和相关星系的法律。

We were a little too smart with this one and it’s kinda backfired. Sometimes you gotta dream big, you know? Anyway. we were looking to move some encrypted data to one of our data havens and decided to hide it in a ship’s blackbox. They filled the ship with “valuable” stuff as a decoy in case it got attacked. The plan worked a little too well and the cargo might have attracted the wrong kind of attention. They stole all the cargo but missed the blackbox. Bad news is the ship is now swarming with outlaws.
The data on that blackbox is useless to them, but we need it. If you can get it back for us, we can give you a nice cut from what we make. Seems like a fair deal, right?
Head to [LOCATION] and after you’ve done your thing take the flight recorder to [DESTINATION].
-Bit Zeros
19ne0mp.description_zh:
这次我们自作聪明，结果翻车了。人嘛，总得有点梦想对吧？我们本来想把一批加密数据藏进飞船黑匣子，运到咱们的数据据点。为了骗过敌人，还特意在船上堆满“值钱货”当诱饵。结果这招太灵了——东西是唬住人了，可也引来了不该来的人。货全被抢光了，唯独漏了黑匣子。坏消息是，现在那艘船周围全是不法分子，跟蜂窝似的。

那黑匣子里的数据对他们屁用没有，但我们非得拿回来。你要是能帮我们搞到手，分你一大笔，这买卖不亏吧？

去 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 把事儿办了，然后把飞行记录仪送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>。

- 零比特
